newsitem.title: CHINA: China to invest 330 mln yuan to expand Hainan port.
newsitem.headline: China to invest 330 mln yuan to expand Hainan port.

text.p: The state-run China International Capital Corp Ltd agreed to invest 330 million yuan ($39.7 million) in port expansion on the southern island province of Hainan, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
The expansion of the second phase of the Yangpu port would include the construction of three new 20,000-tonne berths, it said.
The port's handling capacity would expand by 1.2 million tonnes handling capacity a year, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
